mechanism3.name: Checked relationship attribute projection
mechanism3.currentPath: rust/processing/src/prepass.rs resolve_prepass_with_style_seeds is shared by native and WASM; void/fill relations fully decode then consume only references4 and5
mechanism3.existingFoundation: rust/core/src/decoder/caches.rs decode_string_by_id_transient reuses parse_at, validates the entire unused tail, and preserves requested-id/parsed-id cache precedence. It still constructs parser tokens; this is not a general grammar replacement.
mechanism3.diagnosticPrerequisite: Attribute type/count and cache-hit census for void/fill/material/aggregate relationship decodes; distinguish parser token construction from discarded AttributeValue construction, and place this interval relative to first jobs and full readiness. Instrumented sums are not elapsed load time.
mechanism3.smallestPrototype: Only if measured contribution is material, add one canonical checked reference-pair projection using the existing complete parser and cache rules; use it in shared void/fill loops. Leave styles, relationship lists, aggregate ordering and unit resolution unchanged initially.
semanticProof: Malformed unused fields fail identically; quoted strings/comments/nested values preserve parser validation
Duplicate requested/parsed IDs preserve existing cache precedence
Void and fill indexes retain file-order/last-write behavior, canonical sorted host opening order, and aggregate propagation
Physical openings, material colors, diagnostics and native/WASM mesh identities unchanged
mechanism3.stop: Reject if token parsing dominates, cache warming lost by projection outweighs construction savings, or no end-to-end fresh worker-pool improvement beyond controls. Do not repeat rejected5324 general construction-sink rewrite or treat shipped3987/4000 projection as a new mechanism.

mechanism4.name: Compact geometry-worker source packets
mechanism4.currentPath: One SAB is shared by JS workers, but each IfcAPI.setSourceBytes receives an owned Vec<u8> once per load; FromSource APIs then reuse it. Worker sourceSessionId proves reuse through scanning/style assists/stream-start and recovery.
mechanism4.diagnosticPrerequisite: In separate diagnostic loads, record actual byte-span access union for each geometry worker, including direct source reads outside decode_by_id; report reached-union lower bounds, cross-worker overlap, whole-file scan phases, source-copy bytes and packet-construction cost. Count actual record bytes, not only IDs/jobs.
mechanism4.smallestPrototype: First build a diagnostic-only packet feasibility report from observed complete source accesses; do not implement a partial-source producer until a conservative closure can be proved. Packet feasibility must preserve original global offsets/index and all future recovery reads.
constraints: Shard scanning and styles assistance currently use the same installed source as later geometry; replacing it must preserve exact session ownership and setup/replay order
Global original index offsets require either sparse addressable storage or one canonical remapped source accessor; passing concatenated records to the existing decoder is unsound
Geometry/type/mapped-source/placement/grid/material/void/style references need bounded closure; observed accesses alone do not prove malformed-input or recovery completeness
Avoid resizing WASM linear memory merely to original offset high-water mark, which can erase packet savings
Unknown dependencies must remain explicit refusal during experiments; no silent missing geometry or extra production fallback loader
mechanism4.stop: Reject/defer if reached unions substantially overlap or approach the full file, global-offset address space prevents physical savings, packet construction/remapping dominates, or canonical recovery/dependency completeness needs an unbounded walk.

measurementContract: New mechanisms require their own source-matched baseline/candidate, real parser and physical geometry controls, fresh native GPU full-ready A/B plus output identities, cancellation/abandonment/recovery tests, and a recorded ship/reject/defer verdict. No builds during current native hold.
